title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: This email from Ben updating the sale is a terrible look. Are you doing the draft again?
Nope, he is
Go figure
Chad said, “we need you at home to work the games”
Otherwise who is going to make the credentials is what he’s saying.
But I’m not allowed to ask Ben to do anything per Chad, so here I am, just looking for another job.
Wait you guys actually had such a conversation
That includes that statement
It’s in an email.

It’s absolutely ridiculous. I had a conversation with HR on Wednesday. I am to the point where I can no longer deal with this productively and someone needs to know. I don’t expect it to get better, but it needed to be documented. I also found out they actually never requested a promotion for me, despite my conversations with both Chad and Ron.

Liked “It’s absolutely ridiculous. I had a conversation with HR on Wednesday. I am to the point where I can no longer deal with this productively and someone needs to know. I don’t expect it to get better, but it needed to be documented. I also found out they actually never requested a promotion for me, despite my conversations with both Chad and Ron.”
You should say something, but remember, don’t do nothing too drastic until you have another job in place but I mean
Honestly who cares. I’m to the pint where IDGAF if I don’t have something lined up
We’re good we’ll find something. I think everyday about getting a new job multiple times a day
Yeah. I have a couple of leads and mentally I’m prepared to finish the season if I have to, but at no point will I work for the Tigers once baseball is done this season.
I’ll go work at a PR firm as an account exec, double my salary and have my life back. I’m to that level of I don’t care. I will not commit to being unhappy even if it’s a job I love to do.
100 percent
Then you see if they have any more jobs and tell me
I’m in a diff situation but it’s kinda all the same
It’s all the same, you’re just on the opposite side of the street.
Liked “Then you see if they have any more jobs and tell me ”
My boss is a douche and they keep wanting me to churn out more and more and I’m massively underpaid. This team sucks. I’ve been drinking every night.
I’m surprised you still get to travel
With us being so bad
They cut like six of my trips
If I know of any leads on good stories, I’ll give them to you. But we are in the same boat, there’s just nothing to talk about.
I know
I’m supposed to fill a magazine with content on guys likely to not get traded or who’s performance isn’t abysmal...I’m left with the same two guys we’ve been taking about all season.
I’m not lying when I say I feel like crying like every day at work. Yesterday not being able to get an uber for 20 min after game was rough
Emphasized “I’m not lying when I say I feel like crying like every day at work. Yesterday not being able to get an uber for 20 min after game was rough”
I feel that on so many levels
It just lingers
And you have to face it everyday.
